results.description: Each list item includes post metadata (title/filename, date if available)

payload.evidence: components/__tests__/PostCard.test.tsx: 4/4 tests pass (renders title, formatted date, preview). However app/__tests__/page.test.tsx: 'shows title and date for each post' FAILS — test expects 'Jan 15, 2025' but component renders 'Jan 14, 2025' due to timezone offset in toLocaleDateString for '2025-01-15T00:00:00Z' in test environment. payload.notes: Test failure caused by timezone-sensitive date formatting: toLocaleDateString converts UTC midnight to local date which can shift by -1 day. The PostCard component itself renders metadata correctly (title, date, preview) as proven by PostCard unit tests.
